metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins by Ahmed Abbas.

plugins.name: my-vault
plugins.description: Turn your Claude Code sessions into an interlinked Obsidian vault. Captures the decisions, reasoning and context buried in your transcripts as atomic notes, each anchored to a machine-verified verbatim quote. Nothing is uploaded; nothing is written without you asking.

plugins.name: my-voice
plugins.description: Draft in your own voice. Forces Claude to build a structured model of you-as-writer from your own writing samples before drafting, then critique the draft as you would. Corpus-driven, with a deterministic typography backstop.
